offensive.name: Freefall
offensive.description: Everything falls. You decide which way, and how far.

tiers.text: The damage is turned into Force damage. A creature that fails is lifted 20 feet and let go: it takes 2d6 Force damage from the fall and lands Prone.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Force · lifted 20 ft and dropped — 2d6 force and Prone

tiers.text: The lift becomes 40 feet and the fall 4d6 Force damage. It lands so hard that it cannot stand up until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: The lift becomes 40 ft — 4d6 on landing · they can't stand up until the end of their next turn

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.duration: can't stand until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: The lift becomes 60 feet and the fall 6d6, and you choose which way it falls — down, or sideways at any surface or creature within 60 feet. A creature it is thrown into takes the same falling damage and is knocked Prone too.
tiers.card: The lift becomes 60 ft — 6d6 · you choose the direction of the fall, and whatever it hits takes the same and falls Prone

tiers.text: Down is no longer where it was. A creature that fails falls upward 100 feet and hangs there, helpless and Restrained, until the start of your next turn — then the world remembers it, and it falls the whole way back for 10d6 Force damage, landing Prone.
tiers.card: They fall UP 100 ft and hang Restrained until your next turn — then drop the whole way for 10d6 and land Prone

rider.when: the start of your next turn

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.duration: aloft until the start of your next turn

offensive.name: Center of Mass
offensive.description: You do not strike the crowd. You give it something to fall toward.

tiers.text: The target becomes a point of mass. Every other creature of your choice within 10 feet of it makes the seal's save; those that fail are pulled into the nearest space beside it, and the target and each creature pulled take 1d6 Force damage for every creature pulled in.
tiers.card: Everyone you choose within 10 ft: save or be pulled onto the target — it and each of them take 1d6 per creature pulled

tiers.text: The reach becomes 15 feet, and everything pulled in lands in a heap — Prone, and unable to willingly move away from the target until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: The reach becomes 15 ft · the pulled are left Prone and can't move away from the target until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: The reach becomes 20 feet and the collision 1d10 per creature. Loose objects and anything thrown or fired fall toward the mass as well: until the end of your next turn, every ranged attack made against a creature within 20 feet of the target is pulled into the target instead.
tiers.card: The reach becomes 20 ft and each collision 1d10 · until your next turn, ranged attacks at anyone within 20 ft curve into the target

tiers.text: Singularity. The point collapses. Every creature of your choice within 30 feet that fails is dragged to the center and Restrained there, taking 2d10 Force damage for every creature caught with it. At the start of your next turn the singularity bursts: everything caught is thrown 30 feet outward and lands Prone.
tiers.card: SINGULARITY — everyone you choose within 30 ft who fails is dragged in and Restrained, 2d10 per creature caught · next turn it bursts: 30 ft out, Prone

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.duration: until the start of your next turn

supportive.name: Local Gravity
supportive.description: Down is a suggestion you have stopped taking.

tiers.text: You take no damage from falling, and you choose which surface is down for you — walking on walls and ceilings at your normal speed.
tiers.card: No falling damage · choose your own down — walk on walls and ceilings at full speed

tiers.text: At the start of each of your turns choose to be Light or Heavy. Light: you fly at your walking speed. Heavy: you cannot be moved, knocked Prone, or grappled against your will, and your melee hits push their target 10 feet.
tiers.card: Each turn choose — Light: fly at walking speed · Heavy: can't be moved, downed or grappled, and your melee hits push 10 ft

buff.choice: Light (fly) or Heavy (immovable, hits push 10 ft)

tiers.text: Things orbit you now. Ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage as they curve away, and up to three small objects circle you; as a bonus action you may hurl one at a creature within 60 feet — a ranged attack using your seal attack bonus, dealing 1d10 + your Verum Modifier Force damage.
tiers.card: Ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage · three objects orbit you — bonus action: hurl one for 1d10+{VM} force

buff.defense: disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks against you

tiers.text: You are a gravity well. Allies within 30 feet may also choose Light or Heavy each turn; ranged and spell attacks against you, and against allies within 10 feet of you, have disadvantage; and once per round, when a projectile misses you, you may send it back to strike its source.
tiers.card: Allies within 30 ft choose Light or Heavy too · ranged and spell attacks against you and allies within 10 ft at disadvantage · once a round, return a missed projectile

buff.defense: disadvantage on ranged and spell attacks within 10 ft of you

control.name: Tenfold Weight
control.description: It was always this heavy. You have simply stopped holding it up for them.

tiers.text: A creature that fails has its speed halved and cannot Dash or jump. A flying creature that fails drops 30 feet at once, and falls the rest of the way if it cannot hover.
tiers.card: Speed halved · no Dash or jumping · flyers drop 30 ft at once, and fall if they can't hover

tiers.text: Its own weight betrays it. It has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and saving throws, and it cannot fly, levitate, or be lifted while the weight holds.
tiers.card: Disadvantage on Str and Dex checks and saves · no flying, levitating or being lifted

penalty.disadvantage: Strength and Dexterity checks and saves

tiers.text: Pinned. A creature that fails is knocked Prone and cannot stand while the weight holds; on its turn it may spend its action on a Strength check against your Verum DC to rise.
tiers.card: Pinned Prone — can't stand while it holds · an action and a Str check {DC} to rise

conditions.name: Pinned
conditions.escape: an action and a Strength check vs Verum DC

tiers.text: The weight becomes crushing. A pinned creature takes Five Times your Verum Modifier in Force damage at the start of each of its turns, and the ground beneath it buckles — everything within 20 feet becomes difficult terrain.
tiers.card: Crushing — 5×VM force at the start of each of their turns while pinned · 20 ft of buckled ground becomes difficult terrain

control.name: Which Way Is Down
control.description: Everyone agrees on down. You are here to take a second opinion.

tiers.text: For a creature that fails, down turns upside down: it falls 10 feet upward and hangs there, unable to move except by climbing or flying, until the end of its next turn — then drops back.
tiers.card: They fall 10 ft up and hang — no moving except climbing or flying — until the end of their next turn, then drop

conditions.name: Aloft
conditions.duration: until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: The fall upward becomes 20 feet. While it hangs, it has disadvantage on attack rolls, and anything it isn't gripping tightly falls away from it — it drops one held item of your choice.
tiers.card: The fall up becomes 20 ft · while hanging they attack at disadvantage and drop one held item of your choice

tiers.text: Choose any direction as down for each creature that fails — sideways, backward, up. It falls 30 feet that way, taking 3d6 Force damage if it strikes anything before it stops.
tiers.card: Pick each one's down — up, sideways, back · they fall 30 ft that way, 3d6 force if they hit anything

movement.fall: 30 ft in a direction you choose

tiers.text: Rewrite the room. While the effect lasts, at the start of each of your turns you choose which way is down inside the area; every unsecured creature and object there falls 60 feet that way, taking 6d6 Force damage if it strikes anything. Only you, and those you choose, keep your own down.
tiers.card: Each of your turns, choose the direction of down across the whole area — everything unsecured falls 60 ft that way, 6d6 if it hits · you and yours are spared

movement.fall: 60 ft in a direction you choose, each of your turns

creation.name: Held Aloft
creation.description: Nothing you build has to touch the ground unless you want it to.

tiers.text: Your creations need no footing. Structures may be raised in midair and hold there, and Objects you make orbit you and return to your hand when thrown. They are impossibly heavy to anything else: a creature that strikes one of your Structures is knocked Prone by the recoil.
tiers.card: Structures can hang in midair · your Objects orbit you and return when thrown · strike a Structure and be knocked Prone

tiers.text: Your Constructs are dense beyond their size: they cannot be moved against their will, and their slams knock Large or smaller creatures Prone. As an action you may drop one Structure segment onto the space beneath it — each creature there takes 4d10 Force damage (a Strength save halves).
tiers.card: Constructs can't be moved and their slams knock Prone · action: drop a Structure segment for 4d10 force (Str half)

tiers.text: What you build moves when you ask it to. As a bonus action, move one Structure up to 30 feet in any direction — through the air, if you like — and any creature it passes through takes 4d10 Force damage and is knocked Prone (a Strength save halves the damage and keeps it standing).
tiers.card: Bonus action: fly a Structure 30 ft in any direction — anyone in its path takes 4d10 force and falls Prone (Str half, stays up)

tiers.text: Your Constructs carry their own gravity. A creature hostile to you that starts its turn within 10 feet of one cannot willingly move away from it, and when a Construct is destroyed it collapses into a brief singularity — everything within 20 feet is pulled to where it stood and takes 6d10 Force damage, landing Prone (a Strength save halves the damage and resists the pull).
tiers.card: Enemies starting within 10 ft of a Construct can't move away · a destroyed Construct collapses: 20-ft pull, 6d10 force, Prone (Str half)

utility.name: Pull of the World
utility.description: Everything is heavy with where it wants to go. You can feel it.

tiers.text: Fall as slowly as you like. Halve or double the weight of an object you touch, up to 500 pounds. Know the exact weight and balance of anything you hold, and sense hollow spaces and dense masses — caves, false walls, buried things — within 60 feet.
tiers.card: Fall safely · halve or double an object's weight (to 500 lb) · sense hollows and buried masses within 60 ft

tiers.text: Walk on any surface as if it were the floor, leap up to 60 feet, and move a single object of up to a ton slowly through the air by changing which way it falls.
tiers.card: Walk on any surface · leap 60 ft · float an object of up to a ton slowly through the air

tiers.text: Fly at your walking speed, and carry up to five willing companions in your pull — they float along with you as long as they stay within 30 feet.
tiers.card: Fly at walking speed · carry five willing companions within 30 ft along with you

tiers.text: The sky is a direction too. Lift and move anything up to the weight of a house, slowly and exactly, for as long as the seal lasts. Or read the pull of the heavens — know precisely where you stand in the world and the hour, from anywhere under an open sky, and feel any great mass within a mile, however deep it is buried.
tiers.card: Move anything up to a house's weight · or read the heavens — know where and when you are, and feel any great mass within a mile

complementEffects.name: Impact
complementEffects.description: The seal lands with more weight than anything its size should carry.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus Force damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6), and a Large or smaller target is knocked Prone.
effect.card: +1 die force · Large or smaller are knocked Prone

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Bonus damage increases to two dice, and Huge creatures are knocked Prone as well.
upgrades.card: +2 dice · Huge creatures fall Prone too

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Bonus damage increases to three dice, and a creature knocked Prone this way cannot stand up until the end of its next turn.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · those knocked Prone can't stand until the end of their next turn

complementEffects.name: Counterweight
complementEffects.description: Something has to carry the weight. You volunteer.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, one ally within 30 feet cannot be moved or knocked Prone against its will and has advantage on Strength saving throws until the start of your next turn. You take its weight: your own speed is halved for the same time.
effect.card: An ally within 30 ft can't be moved or knocked Prone, advantage on Str saves — but your speed is halved until your next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: You may steady two allies, and the effect lasts 1 minute.
Level 11+: The weight no longer slows you — your speed is unaffected — and each steadied ally takes no damage from falling.
upgrades.card: No more speed cost · steadied allies take no falling damage

complementEffects.name: Downforce
complementEffects.description: The air above them gets very heavy, very fast.

effect.text: Creatures that fail have their speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn, and a flying creature that fails descends 20 feet at once.
effect.card: −10 ft speed until the end of their next turn · flyers drop 20 ft

upgrades.text: Level 5+: They also cannot jump, fly, or levitate until the end of their next turn — a flier that fails falls.
upgrades.card: No jumping, flying or levitating until the end of their next turn — fliers fall

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Creatures that fail are knocked Prone and cannot stand up until the end of their next turn.
upgrades.card: Knocked Prone and can't stand until the end of their next turn
